caseFunctionHints.nominative: Usually marks the subject or names the topic of the clause.
caseFunctionHints.genitive: Often shows possession, source, relationship, or description.
caseFunctionHints.dative: Usually marks the indirect object, means, location, association, or advantage.
caseFunctionHints.accusative: Usually functions as the direct object or marks extent and direction.

verbAspectHints.present: Imperfective aspect: action viewed as ongoing, repeated, or in progress.
verbAspectHints.imperfect: Imperfective aspect in past time: action viewed as unfolding or repeated.
verbAspectHints.aorist: Perfective aspect: action viewed as a whole event.
verbAspectHints.perfect: Stative/resultative aspect: completed action with continuing results.
verbAspectHints.pluperfect: Past stative/resultative aspect: a completed action with prior results.

paradigmPatterns.article:definite: ὁ, τοῦ, τῷ, τόν ... / οἱ, τῶν, τοῖς, τούς
paradigmPatterns.declension:third-declension: Variable stem patterns with consonant or vowel stem changes
